title: Domain Walls From Confining Bubbles: $SU(N_{c})$ Yang Mills at Finite $θ$
summary: We study the confinement phase transition in SU($N_{c}$) pure Yang-Mills theory at finite $θ\neq 0$ using the Improved Holographic QCD (IHQCD) model. We show that the critical temperature, as a function of $θ$ for large but fixed $N_{c}$, is reduced, thus decreasing the amount of supercooling in the confinement phase transition. Upon completion of the confinement phase transition, a network of domain walls can be produced, owing to the multi-branched vacuum structure of Yang-Mills theory at finite $θ$.
